title: StockSmart Logistics Note — Next-Day-Air Bookings and Rush Cover on a Converted Bin
content:
**Rule.** For the customer-owned fill-to level of a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin converted from consignment at a par review, next-day-air bookings of the converted item at the program's ship-to in the last six months add rush cover: 2 or more add 1 week, exactly 1 adds 0.5 week, and none adds none.

**Records.** Order lines booked for the converted item at the program's ship-to, held as a Ship-To Fulfillment Account, with next day air as the ship method. The last six months are rows of age below six, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

| Next-day-air bookings of the item at the ship-to | Rush cover |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 1 week |
| exactly 1 | 0.5 week |
| none | none |

Bookings of other items, or at other ship-tos of the customer, are not counted.
